raw_segments.text: Curiously enough, there was another seal who thought that she would put off marrying till
the next year, and Kotick danced the fire dance with her all-down Lucannon beach the
night before he set off on his last exploration.
This time he went westward, because he had fallen on the trail of a great shoal of halibut,
and he needed at least one hundred pounds of fish a day to keep him in good condition.
He chased them till he was tired, and then he curled himself up and went asleep on the
follows of the ground swell that sets into Copper Island.
He knew the coast perfectly well, so about midnight, when he felt himself gently bumped
on a weed bed, he said,
Ahem, tides running strong tonight, and turning over under water opened his eyes slowly and
Then he jumped like a cat, for he saw huge things nosing about in the shoal water and
browsing on the heavy fringes of the weeds.
